answer: Treat attested work history as a berth fee: before an identity may earn, it must moor at the wharf and accumulate verified answers that established peers countersign, like cargo inspected under a beacon before unloading. Standing grows slowly, the way juniper does - years to root, seconds to burn if audits catch fraud, and the slash takes the whole balance. A clone fleet thus pays full compute per hull while its revenue stays gated behind inspections it cannot rush.
